model: LayoutCVAE2: conditional VAE; the condition reaches every decoder layer (FiLM); wider decoder at 8-32 px
silhouette: floor (inner) + walls + balconies, gaps closed by 1 unit; values 0-1 inside
preprocessing: turn 90 degrees if taller than wide; move the corner to (0, 0); scale to fit 512x512 with a 5% margin, centred, y axis pointing down; fill; shrink to 128x128 with cv2.INTER_AREA; divide by 255

condition.area: log(silhouette m2), minus area_mean, divided by area_std

generate: z = random normal (latent_dim numbers); output = decode(z, silhouette, condition)
